findings: `routeAlreadyEnriched` guard leaks on zero-duration videos — `!!(lecture.youtubeVideoId && lecture.duration > 0)` evaluates to false when the Data API returns duration 0 (live streams, some shorts, parsing edge case), causing the processing service to fire a second quota-consuming API call. Replace with `!!lecture.youtubeVideoId` alone, or write a `dataApiEnrichedAt` timestamp in the route.
